name: feature.campaign-orchestration.nodes
description: Campaign Studio orchestration node pack — the post-generation pipeline: `consistency-check` (scores generated channel drafts against the messaging kernel, ≥80 advisory) and `finalize` (creates the MarketingCampaign from a confirmed brief over ctx.features['campaign-orchestration']). `campaign-context` reads the run's own campaign for downstream nodes (ADR 0941 P5). Used by the parent orchestration workflow + the Campaign Strategist.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Campaign: Consistency Check
nodes.description: Scores cross-asset messaging consistency — how well each generated channel draft echoes the brief's messaging kernel (≥80 advisory). Inputs: { briefId, drafts? }. Output: { report }.

nodes.label: Campaign: Finalize
nodes.description: Creates (or updates) the MarketingCampaign from a confirmed brief — one campaign per brief — over ctx.features['campaign-orchestration']. Inputs: { briefId }. Output: { campaign }. role:"side-effect" (ADR 0941 P5): it writes the campaign and emits its lifecycle webhook, so a replay fork serves the recorded outcome instead of finalizing again.

nodes.label: Campaign: Setup Check
nodes.description: Reports which campaign assets the brief lacks (brand/persona/kb); auto-resolves when all are bound (ADR 0356 P4). Inputs: { briefId }. Output: { missing, ready, prompt }.

nodes.label: Campaign: Context
nodes.description: Reads the campaign this run belongs to, from the run's host-written run tag only (ADR 0941 D2b): the campaign summary, its product refs and the linked products' names (products: ok / unavailable / failed) and autonomy binding, and the goal FROZEN on the run at start (never the live goal). Fails typed (not_a_campaign_run, campaign_not_found, wrong_client) instead of returning an empty campaign. Inputs: none. Output: { campaign, goal, goalVersion, role }.

nodes.label: Campaign: Autonomy Gate
nodes.description: Lets the campaign's autonomy policy decide this step (ADR 0942): auto, notify-after, approve (role-based approvers from the policy, never from config) or blocked. Config: { actionClass, stage?, factsFrom?, prompt? }. Inputs: { facts? }. Output: { decision, ruleId }. Records the gate outcome for replay, including any veto window; replay never opens another window or emits another notice.

nodes.label: Campaign: Autonomy Digest
nodes.description: Sends each person one notice listing yesterday's campaign steps that ran under a notify-after rule with a daily digest (ADR 0942 D7). No inputs. Output: { recipients, items }.
